request: 最新版Windows Release不能选择Aide目录以外作为文档目录，检查工作目录、引用、缓存等相关路径并修复
acceptance: Windows Release directory defaults do not mask explicit .env/process AIDE_LOCAL_ROOT, AIDE_WORKSPACE or AIDE_CONTEXT values.
Fresh Windows Release uses the existing Windows local-root browsing policy rather than forcing package/workspace.
Host port/update agents preserve the selected Compose override list and extra directory permissions.
Both Windows architecture launcher packages include the PowerShell port watcher.
External Windows-style document paths support listing, approval-before-write and readback without redirecting to the workspace.
Native Windows Docker Desktop/folder-dialog validation remains separately identified; never infer it from macOS or fixtures.
scope: targeted PowerShell/Go regression and Windows CI coverage
bilingual workspace-path documentation and task record

requirements.summary: User confirmed latest Release on Windows. Shared local boundary affects workspace, system documents and local references.
evidence: start.ps1 offline initialization and documented default-root policy

design.summary: Keep source-install defaults and explicit directory scopes; remove offline preemption, retain Compose overrides, fix both architecture archives. No container code or UI changes required.

implementation.summary: Fixed directory setting precedence, watcher/update Compose retention and missing Windows AMD64 watcher. Added actual PowerShell execution tests and external document approval/write/readback regression.

verification.summary: Local checks PASS: original PowerShell prefix reproduces package/workspace pinning; six corrected precedence cases and two actual watcher iterations pass under macOS PowerShell 7.6.9 with Docker adapter fixture. Twelve image-slot cases, 5 Windows lifecycle checks, 3 local-root checks, 15 offline bundle checks and 20 CI-contract checks pass. Offline Go mount/helper suites pass; 17 server directory/document tests pass, including physical external write/readback with Windows-style Unicode path, no premature write and no workspace fallback. Native Windows PowerShell 5.1, Docker Desktop and native folder dialog NOT_RUN on this Mac; issue remains open.
evidence: python3 scripts/agent-route.py verify quick: PASS (receipt in .agent-state/directory-audit/quick.log)

documentation.summary: Chinese/English guides document actual directory scopes, permissions, other-drive setup and verification limits.

cleanup.summary: Scoped public-source diff reviewed; private checkout, launcher local override, real .env/data and live 9999 preserved. Only disposable test fixtures/containers used.

release.summary: No new release, merge, push or live 9999 deployment. A Windows launcher-only repair archive is prepared for native verification; it does not contain an application image or private implementation.
evidence: Current user request: diagnose and inspect Windows Release directory behavior

rollback: Restore backed-up start.ps1, scripts/watch-port.ps1 and scripts/update-agent.ps1 in the Windows Release folder, then restart its launcher. No user configuration is rewritten by the repair archive.
handoff: Local fix and related checks complete; native Windows end-to-end acceptance is outstanding. Other drives still require explicit local-directory setup and host confirmation. No release or 9999 deployment performed.
